title: selaginella haematodes
intro: Selaginella haematodes, commonly known as the crimson selaginella or red rose, is a species of spore-producing plant in the family Selaginellaceae. This ancient plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella haematodes include modulating the immune system, reducing oxidative stress, and exhibiting anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
